input.command:
python3 - <<'EOF'
p='docs/spec.md'; s=open(p).read()
old_abl="""- **ABL-05** The ablation study shows at least one switch that hurts learning.
  - Given the ablation study report, when it is read, then at least one of the 3 ablations is reported as "hurts learning"."""
new_abl="""- **ABL-05** When no switch hurts learning, the study is still complete: the result is recorded as a finding in the notes, and S1 doesn't count as failed.
  - Given a study report where all 3 ablations show "no detectable difference", when the stage is checked, then it passes, and the notes page records that no switch hurt learning as a finding (EXPL-02)."""
assert old_abl in s; s=s.replace(old_abl,new_abl)
i=s.index("## Assumptions"); j=s.index("## Changelog")
s=s[:i]+"""## Assumptions
- The learner is the only user; the lab runs on their laptop.
- A tiny test environment exists only to prove the shared core; it is not a second lab environment.
- Snake: 20 × 20 grid, starting length 3, step limit 100 × length, rewards +10 / −10 / 0.
- Agent settings: exploration 1.0 → 0.01 over half the games, memory of 100,000 steps, discount 0.9, frozen copy refreshed every 1,000 steps, fixed 0.1 exploration when decay is off.
- Study size: 5 training seeds per agent, 100 held-out games, evaluation every 50 games, full study ≤ 10 hours.
- The scripted baseline avoids immediately fatal moves; the agent may only tie it, and that bar is kept on purpose.

"""+s[j:]
s=s.replace("**Status:** Draft · **Last updated:** 2026-10-18","**Status:** Approved · **Last updated:** 2026-10-18")
s=s.replace("| 2026-10-18 | Initial spec | brief.md | all |","| 2026-10-18 | Initial spec | brief.md | all |\n| 2026-10-18 | No hurting ablation is a finding, not a failure; proposed settings confirmed | review | ABL-05 |")
open(p,'w').write(s)
EOF
D=../plugin/dev-team/scripts/dt.py
python3 $D request trace UR-25 BASE-02; python3 $D request trace UR-26 ABL-05 EXPL-02; python3 $D request trace UR-27 ABL-05
python3 $D request list --open --owner spec; python3 $D lint 2>&1 | tail -5; python3 $D roadmap; git status --short
